# Quote the project, not just the word count.

> Free private translator quote calculator. Price new words, fuzzy matches, QA, DTP, rush work, and a minimum project fee in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
